name: io.github.JohannsenLum/linkedin-api-mcp
title: LinkedIn
description: Read LinkedIn profiles, companies, jobs, posts and messages through your own logged-in browser session

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Your LinkedIn li_at session cookie. Optional if you have already stored it in the OS keyring with `linkedin-api-mcp auth`, which is the recommended route — this cookie is equivalent to being logged in as you.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Run the browser headless. Defaults to true; set to 0 to watch what it does.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum seconds between LinkedIn actions. Defaults to 2.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_MAX_PER_HOUR
environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling on LinkedIn actions per rolling hour. Defaults to 120. The server refuses past this rather than sleeping, so an agent in a loop is told to stop.
